title: SQL: Guard fill resampling in MSSQL, PostgreSQL and MySQL

target.summary: `stripSQLComments` strips `#` comments using the naive regex `#[^\n]*` (`reHashComment`), which matches `#` characters inside quoted strings and JSON paths, truncating queries and causing SQL syntax errors.
notes: faulty regex replacement stripping # comments regardless of quotes
definition of stripSQLComments function whose behavior is wrong
call site of stripSQLComments in Interpolate
